senses.gloss:
m. (-कः)
A shrub, (Barleria cristata); also शैरेयक.

f. (-न्ध्री)
1 A female artist.
2 A name of DRAUPADĪ. see सैरिन्ध्री.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Relating or belonging to a plough, &c.
2 Having furrows.
m. (-कः)
1 A Ploughman.
2 A plough-ox, &c.
E.
सीर a plough, ठक् aff.

m. (-न्ध्रः)
A menial servant, one employed to dress and decorate the person and perform all servile offices; also who may be employed in the chase, snaring animals, &c. the offspring of a Dasyu by an Ayogava female.
f. (-न्ध्री)
1 An independant female artisan working in another person's house.
2 A female attendant in the women's apartments.
3 A woman of one of the mixed and degraded classes.
4 DRAUPADĪ, the wife of the Pāṇḍu princes, and who upon the temporary servitude of her husbands, became workwoman in the house of the Rāja of Virāṭa.
E.
सीर a plough, धृ to hold or take, aff. क, and मुक् augment, अण् added, and the penultimate vowel changed optionally to इ; whence also सैरन्ध्री, or स्वैर independent, धृ to hold or be, aff. कन्, fem. aff. ङीष्, and form irr.

m. (-भः)
1 A buffalo.
2 Svarga, INDRA'S heaven or paradise.
E.
सीर the plough or the sun, इभ an elephant, aff. अण्.

m. (-यः)
A plant, (Barleria cristata.)
E.
सीर a plough, अण् aff., सैर relating to a plough, (turned up by it, &c.) and छ added; also with कन् added सैरीयक, and with ढक् aff. सैरेय or सैरेयक.

m. (-यः)
A shrub, (Barleria cristata); see सैरीय; also with कन् added सैरेयक.
